date_note: The page gives no earlier day than its publication on 26 November.
title: Turkey's MİT reportedly dismantles a cyber espionage network targeting wireless networks of critical institutions and defense firms; 2 jailed pending trial
summary: Hürriyet Daily News and Daily Sabah, both citing anonymous security sources, report that MİT and Istanbul Police detained two suspects accused of trying to infiltrate wireless networks of critical institutions and defense firms. The reports say the pair mapped Wi-Fi networks along set routes in Ankara and Istanbul and that MİT determined they worked for an unnamed foreign intelligence service. Both are reported jailed pending trial.
plain: Turkish media, citing security sources, report that intelligence and police detained 2 suspects who allegedly mapped Wi-Fi networks near sensitive sites for an unnamed foreign intelligence service.
exec: Turkish media citing security sources describe a state operation against alleged Wi-Fi spying on defense and critical public institutions; no official statement was read.
